title: File watcher freeze
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in Godot 4.5 stable 

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable unknown - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:11:04 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900HX (32 threads) - 31.06 GiB memory

### Issue description

I use linux Manjaro (Based on Arch). I write my gdscript code with vscode, and every time I change some code and then tab back into godot, it frezes for multiple minutes. I have a rather large project, but this should not be happening nevertheless. I went ahead and did some debugging. First, using htop. It showed me, that during this freeze, the cpu utilization is at 100%. So I continued investigation with strace, having it write everything to a file. I took a sample of about 5 seconds and got a file with 75000 lines. It spamms file access calls. Since my project is on a mounted drive, this is not as fast as it would be with an internal ssd. See the attached file

[godot_trace.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22879874/godot_trace.txt)

I know that I could disable the file watcher, but like... I would like to use it. I hope this is fixable

### Steps to reproduce

Open a big project on linux manjaro which is stored on a mounted drive, open it in vscode as well, change on line and wait

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I think this should be applicable to liturally any project, most likely only bigger ones
